summary: Retest of iteration_119 items 1-9. Backend: 32/33 pytest pass (new tests/test_otp_retest_iter120.py 9/10 + test_otp_free_reveal_nov2026.py 23/23). Three new mobile signups in a row all created=true with distinct ids and referral codes, no email key, registration_paid false, approved, no sponsor. Duplicate email register returns 400. A stale referral_code is ignored and no sponsor is set. Takeover guard: 409 with masked email and no session; signs in after phone_verified; mobile-only unverified account signs in. complete-profile: 1-char name returns 400, email clash 409 (case-insensitive), save works and needs_profile then turns false. Logs show no OTP, api_key or full URL after a real send. Financials unchanged before and after the run: wallets 287525.91, txns 2827, +2138810.55 / -94998.68, invoices 2. Frontend (390x844): /login has email, Google and Mobile Number options and no Truecaller. /register has no invite field and reads 'Create my account', and signup lands on /verify-mobile. /complete-profile renders, shows the 409 error and navigates to /shop. Profile has no SIM, Chat-verification or INVITE CODE entries and no Unmatched Route. The dashboard has no invite card, stats and Quick Actions render, and the bank/UPI row shows for admin (payout-eligible). Free reveal at ₹0 shows the number, writes no transaction and leaves the wallet unchanged. Chat sends with no SIM gate. The shop lists 6,183 products. The admin System Wallet / Net-worth screen matches the /admin/finance/net-worth API (user wallets 25,423.44, vendor 8,699, GST 744.40). The admin Products pager changes offset. New issues: the ₹118 'Become a member' banner and card are still on Shop, Dashboard and Profile, and tapping Join loops back to /shop. A typed (unverified) phone on /register can permanently lock the real number owner out of OTP sign-up (409). complete-profile accepts a malformed email. The /register hero still says 'Refer 4 friends'. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: Phone squatting / lockout: /auth/register accepts any self-declared `phone` (no uniqueness, no verification). If someone registers an email+password account with a victim's number, the real owner can never create or enter an OTP account: /auth/otp/verify finds the squatter's row and returns 409 'This number is already on TEST_Squatter (te***@example.com)...'. Reproduced with 9999912311. The message also says 'verify this number from your profile', but Profile has no such option, and /verify-mobile redirects away when user.phone is already set.

minor.issue: The email format is not validated: 'notanemail' is accepted and saved (200). Use EmailStr. A race could also cause an uncaught DuplicateKeyError on update_one, which would return 500.
_mask_email pads one '*' per hidden character, so the masked email reveals the exact length of the local part (te****************@example.com). Use a fixed number of stars.
Email signups still get approval_status 'pending', while mobile signups get 'approved'. The two paths are inconsistent now that signup is free.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Become a member · ₹118 … unlimited service numbers free' banner still shows on Shop, Dashboard and Profile. Profile also shows a 'FREE ACCOUNT … ₹118 one time / Become a member' card. Tapping Join opens /payment, which now just redirects to /shop, where the same banner shows again: a dead CTA loop. The 'service numbers free' perk is also wrong now that numbers are free for everyone.

issues: The hero subtitle still says 'Refer 4 friends to unlock recurring rewards.' (app/register.tsx:78), but referrals were removed.

action_items: Remove or rework the ₹118 SubscribeBanner and MembershipCard on the shop, dashboard and profile screens (src/subscription.tsx). The Join button currently loops /payment -> /shop.

Stop phone squatting. Either drop the free-text phone from /auth/register, or store it as unverified in a separate field so it is not matched by /auth/otp/verify. Also add a real 'verify my number' path for logged-in users whose phone is already set, or change the 409 text, which points to a Profile option that does not exist.
Validate the email format in /auth/otp/complete-profile (EmailStr) and catch DuplicateKeyError there.
Optional: decide whether email signups should also be approval_status 'approved'.

server.py is 11,404 lines and should be split further.
/services/{id}/reveal-phone still writes a ₹0 phone_reveal_invoices row and notifies the provider on every first reveal. There are no money rows, but invoices keep growing.

rca_of_issue: Phone lockout: register() stores payload.phone verbatim, and otp_auth.verify_login_otp matches users by phone before applying the takeover guard. The guard (unverified phone + password) then returns 409 forever, so the real owner has no way to claim the number. Repro: POST /auth/register {phone: X} -> seed an OTP for X -> POST /auth/otp/verify -> 409.
